name: cf-ai-tradedesk
description: Runs the worker and the front end together for local development.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix worker install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names worker,frontend --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix worker run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:no-ai: concurrently --names worker,frontend --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix worker run dev:no-ai" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix worker test && npm --prefix frontend test
